interpretation.correctedHarness: Both arms use byte-identical minimal Tamagui configs; the prior default-theme import mismatch was removed.
interpretation.moduleLengths: Rendered module lengths are pre-minification attribution, while artifact bytes and gzip bytes are exact emitted sizes.
interpretation.tamaguiGzip: Tamagui-attributable gzip is measured from an explicit production-minified Rollup chunk containing tamagui, @tamagui/*, workspace core/packages/ui dist modules, and @react-native/normalize-color when pulled by the Tamagui runtime. It excludes fixture code, shared benchmark code, React, react-dom, scheduler, Vite helpers, and other dependencies.
interpretation.remainingDelta: The remaining V3 delta is framework surface led by @tamagui/style-grammar and @tamagui/web, not fixture/config/theme code.
